audience: property operators with RemoteLock API access and a dedicated app for their own account

useCases.title: Check lock status and battery
useCases.text: List devices at a property and inspect a lock’s connectivity, battery level and current state.

useCases.title: Review who can open a door
useCases.text: List a lock’s access users and guests, then inspect a selected person’s access grants and validity window.

useCases.title: Create time-limited guest access
useCases.text: Check for an existing guest, create a guest credential for the requested dates, then grant access to the chosen door. This changes who can enter the property.

useCases.title: Deactivate a former guest or contractor
useCases.text: Inspect the intended person and deactivate their credential when requested. Their PIN or card stops working on every door.

useCases.title: Unlock a specifically requested door
useCases.text: Inspect the intended lock, then unlock it only after an explicit request and confirmation for that door. The command physically unlocks the door.
